disposition.reason: An appeal of a Burlington DRB approval for an addition to a residential treatment center. The documents don't say the addition adds residential units, so it is not new housing.

evidence.quote: Appellant Kevin Fisher appealed from a decision of the Development Review Board
granting Major Impact Development approval and site plan approval for an addition to Appellee-Applicant Lund Family Center, Inc.’s existing building,
The Center provides a residence for a maximum of 20 clients at any time.
The parties dispute how certain uses of the new addition and existing space in the facility should be categorized as principal or accessory uses

judgments.note: Person ruling: an addition to a residential building that doesn't explicitly add units is not new housing.
